title: Cadillac Surreal Dreamscape
description: A black Cadillac Escalade drives along an orange elevated road that curves through a vibrant, chaotic surreal landscape. A giant turquoise snake with an orange eye emerges from purple smoke near a glowing Cadillac sign, while a large clock, swirling vortex patterns, graffiti, and other Cadillac vehicles populate the psychedelic scene.
prompt: A black Cadillac Escalade drives on a winding orange elevated road through a surreal psychedelic landscape. A massive turquoise snake with a glowing orange eye emerges from swirling purple smoke beside a large illuminated CADILLAC sign. A giant clock, colorful spiral vortex with hearts and graffiti, a red Cadillac, and other vehicles fill the chaotic scene with floating rocks and vibrant colors.
